SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. 1, Special Branch
No. S. B. D. 2868
Date November 17, 1931
Lcte 18 - 11 - 31

Subject (in full) The Workers' Representatives' Office, 4 Hou Sung Li,
Hochien Road.

Made by D. S. I. Moore Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.S.I.

With reference to the instructions of the Officer
i/c Special Branch appended on attached file regarding the
Workers' Representatives' Office, 4 Hou Sung Li, Hochien
Road, Nyi Dah Kyan (嚴大寬), Lawyer, 468 North Szechuen
Road, was interviewed on November 12, and the position of
this union explained to him.

Nyi promised to go into the matter with his clients
and let the Police know the result of his efforts later.
On November 18, Nyi informed this office by telephone that
his clients had agreed to close down the office at 4 Hou
Sung Li forthwith.

Further enquiries show that the office has closed
down, and that a notice to this effect is posted on the
door of the premises.

D. S. I.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

S.O. "B",
Information and return
please.
J.P. Givens
O. i/c Sp. Br.
NOV. 18 1931
Noted. J.P.G. Staff informed.
R. Bassett.
D. A. D.

日期 1931年11月17日
Lcte 18 - 11 - 31

主题（全称） 赫坚路后宋里4号工人代表办事处。

由 副督察长 穆尔（D. S. I. Moore）呈报 经 亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson），C.S.I. 转呈

关于附卷中特别分部主管官员就赫坚路后宋里4号工人代表办事处一事所附指示，已于11月12日会见四川北路468号律师严大宽（Nyi Dah Kyan），并向其解释了该工会的情况。

严氏承诺将与其委托人商议此事，并随后将其努力的结果告知警方。
11月18日，严氏通过电话通知本办公室，其委托人已同意立即关闭位于后宋里4号的办事处。

进一步调查显示，该办事处已关闭，且在该处所的门上张贴了以此为目的的告示。

副督察长
特别分部主管官员。

“B”区警司，
请知悉并回复。
J.P. 吉文斯（J.P. Givens）
特别分部主管官员
1931年11月18日
已阅。J.P.G. 已通知职员。
R. 巴塞特（R. Bassett）。
助理副总巡官
归档
1931年11月19日

REPORT

Subject (in full) ex workers of Hou Sung Cotton Mill

Made by Supt Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.M.P.

Enquiries indicate that the application of the ex workers
of the Hou Sung Mill for registration has been rejected by
the Social Bureau on the ground that the mill referred to
has been closed down and that there is no necessity for
the workers of a closed mill to form an Union.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c S.B.

SI,
Please call on Nyi Dah Kyah,
explain the true position to him, and
ascertain what he and his clients
intend to do. If they are not
willing to close the offices at No. 4
Han Sung Ri, Bohemia Road, and
suspend activities of their own accord,
it will be necessary to approach
the Municipal Advocate for forms of
his assistance in finding means
to compel them to do so.

D.S.I. Moore,
Please comply with the instructions 7:11:31.
of the Officer-in-charge
H.R. 9/11

暂停活动，

市公署法律顾问，寻求其协助，

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

Subject (in full) The Workers' Representatives Office, 4, Hou Sung Li,
Hochien Road.

Made by D.S.I. Moore Forwarded by Henry Robertson, C.P.I.

With reference to the attached letter from one Nyi
Dah Kyah (嚴大覺) Lawyer, 468, North Szechuen Road, on the
subject of the Workers' Representatives Office, 4, Hou Sung Li,
Hochien Road, enquiries have elicited that the object of the
office is to secure for the ex-workers of the Hou Sung Cotton
Mill which closed down on May 27, 1931 a retiring gratuity
equivalent to 10 months wages and 6 months wages as compensation.
of the 4700 ex-workers of the defunct Hou Sung Mill,
three thousand have registered with this office, including 70
foremen, the latter having contributed $1.00 each to cover
initial expenses.

A Standing Committee of 10 ex-workers of the mill has
been formed, whose names and occupations are as follows :-

| Name | Occupation |
| :--- | :--- |
| Chi Vee-zuan (志維善) | General Duty |
| Joh Hai-tang (華海堂) | Mechanic, Weaving Dept. |
| Nyi Ah-sze (倪阿四) | Foreman in the Coarse Yarn Room |
| Chow Hao-zung (周浩臣) | Mason |
| Chow Tung-zung (周棟臣) | Weaving Room |
| Pan Ming Ziang (潘明祥) | Cotton Weighing Room |
| Hsu Ngoeh-ziang (許玉祥) | Parcel Room |
| Chen Hang-sung (陳杏生) | Cotton Picking Room |
| Sung Li-kweng (沈礼廣) | Spinning Room |
| Yao Keng-su (姚根書) | Weaving Room |

The members of the Committee have given an assurance
that they are in no way connected with politics, and that their
only object is to negotiate with the mill management with a
view to securing a favourable settlement of the question of

Translation of Letter Received

My clients Chih Vi Zai, Ysu Hau Zung,
Yau Kung Ts, representatives of the Hou Sung Mill
workers in last July made representations to the
management for the resumption of work and indemnity.
This orgination is registered with the
Kuomingtang and the Social Bureau and the representatives
names and photos are also filed with them.
They have now rented No. 4 Hou Sung Li,
Hochien Road, and called this place The Workers
Representatives Office, so that meeting can be held
to discuss the livelihood of the workers but, nothing
illegal or of a disturbing nature will be done. They
request me to write to you with reference to this. It
is allowed by law for people to hold meetings, and
this orgination has already been authorised by the
above mentioned parties and this office is considered
essential for the workers cause, so I write this to
inform you of the address, so that they can find ways
and means to present demands to the management for
the solution of various problems.

(Sd) Nyi Dah Kyah
468 North Szechuen Road
Tel. 45523

（批：By command / for your information / forwarded in O.B. / Y.Hoky / C.D. / 31/10/31）
（批：10.0.19.）
（批：Special Branch .6.1.D. / Forwarded for information. / S.I. For attention please / Maxwell. / D. O. ("D" Div.) / 31:10:31. 31 OCT. 1931）

我的委托人志维哉（Chih Vi Zai）、徐浩宗（Ysu Hau Zung）、
姚根书（Yau Kung Ts），作为去年七月后宋棉纺厂
工人的代表，曾向厂方提出复工和赔偿的要求。
该组织已在国民党和社会局注册，代表的
姓名和照片也已存档于上述机构。
他们现已租用赫坚路后宋里4号，
并将此地称为工人代表办事处，以便举行会议
讨论工人的生计问题，但不会进行任何
非法或扰乱性质的活动。他们请求我
就此致函贵处。法律允许人们举行集会，且
该组织已获得上述各方的授权，该办事处被认为
对工人事业至关重要，故我写信告知
地址，以便他们能找到途径和方法向厂方提出诉求，
以解决各种问题。

（签名） 严大觉（Nyi Dah Kyah）
四川北路468号
电话 45523

（批注：奉命 / 供你参考 / 在值班日志中转呈 / Y.Hoky / C.D. / 1931年10月31日）

who is now under arrest
at Gusan Road in connection
with a Kidnapping case.

A. Hillier
A (CB)

DEPUTY COMMISSIONER
(CRIME BRANCH)
Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, 2.8. 193 /
To A.C. (NW)

The last two transfers
made Ypoo one over
strength. K.R. have
17 allowed - This
will leave them 15
men which is
really enough at any
time but we can
fill up on next
recruits. Perhaps A.C.
will send over his
recommendations of
C.P.C. now in hand?
H. Casson
pages.zh:
副专员
（刑事部）
备忘录。
警务处，
工部局。
上海，1931年8月2日
致 西北区助理专员（A.C. (NW)）

最近两次调动使虹口（Ypoo）区人员超编。KR区
核定人数为17人——这将使他们剩下15人，这在任何时候都
确实足够，但我们可以在下一批
新招募人员中补足。也许助理专员
现在可以发送他手头正在处理的
中央巡逻队（C.P.C.）的建议名单？
H. 卡森（H. Casson）
